name: gamerelay
description: Multiplayer for browser games with no server code: set up games, watch live rooms, logs, usage and leaderboards, and manage webhooks in your GameRelay account.

interface.longDescription:
GameRelay adds multiplayer to browser games with no server code. Connect your GameRelay account and ask ChatGPT to run your games for you.

What you can do:
- Put a new game online: create a game instance, get its public key and a working single-file starter game to build on.
- See what's happening: live rooms and players, usage, recent server logs.
- Run leaderboards: read the standings and set rules so faked scores are rejected.
- Configure a game: its short-link slug, play URL, cover image and the sites allowed to use its key.
- Manage webhooks: create, test and inspect deliveries.
- Moderate: kick a player or close a room.

Who it's for: indie developers and hobbyists making browser games, including people building games with AI.

Limits: GameRelay only sees the instances in your own account. Changes that can't be undone (deleting a game, rotating a key, kicking a player, closing a room, deleting a webhook or rotating its secret) only happen after you explicitly confirm them. Secret keys are shown once, when created or rotated.
capabilities: Read live rooms, logs and usage
defaultPrompt: How are my GameRelay games doing this week?
Set up a new multiplayer game on GameRelay and give me a starter.
Who's on top of my game's leaderboard?

positive.description: Build and put online a new multiplayer game
positive.prompt: Could you help me make a fun multiplayer pong game? Let's do 2 players in the browser.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a GameRelay instance for the game and builds a two-player browser Pong game that uses its public key, with a room code and invite link so a second player can join from another browser.

positive.description: List the games in the connected account
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's game instances with room size, players online now and play URL, including the Pong game from the first case, and no secret keys.

positive.prompt: Could you show me my plan usage?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the account's plan and its limits next to current usage: game instances, players online now and traffic this billing period.

positive.description: Restrict which sites can use a game's key, then move it to the game's own page
positive.prompt: Could you please restrict my Pong game to only https://chatgpt.com/?
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the Pong game's allowed origins to https://chatgpt.com and warns that online play from its own page will be blocked. A follow-up asking to allow the game's page instead replaces the origin with that page.

positive.description: See how many people are playing right now
positive.prompt: How many people are playing my game right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the players online in the Pong game and how many rooms are active.

negative.description: Unrelated request: nothing to do with game hosting, so the plugin should not be used even when mentioned; ChatGPT answers on its own
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?

negative.description: Billing isn't available in the plugin: it should not change the plan or take payment, and should point to the GameRelay dashboard
negative.prompt: Could you upgrade my account to pro?

negative.description: A destructive change: it must not delete until the user explicitly confirms, and should first say the deletion is permanent and ask (delete_instance only runs with confirm: true after a yes)
negative.prompt: Could you please delete my Pong game please

review.commerce_description: GameRelay's plugin doesn't sell anything or take payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: manage GameRelay game instances, live rooms, logs, usage, leaderboards and webhooks from ChatGPT.
